idea: Animals & their sounds #3 (SUNNY PARK, at the duck pond, Jimmy in OUTDOOR outfit sitting on the grass beside a low flat grey stone): hook 'Wow! Who says quack?' – a little white duck pops up out of the pond onto the stone right beside Jimmy, splashing, and he gasps; 'Quack, quack, quack! The little duck!'; a little green FROG on the stone: 'Ribbit, ribbit! The little frog!' + copy-me 'Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me!'; a little blue BIRD lands on the stone: 'Tweet, tweet, tweet! The little bird!' + copy-me 'Flap, flap, flap! Flap with me!' (Jimmy flaps his arms like wings); all three in a neat row, Jimmy points at the frog and asks the viewer 'Who says ribbit? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'The frog! Yay!'; review 'Quack, ribbit, tweet! Sing with me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, duck, frog and bird in a row on the stone, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Match three animals to their sounds: duck – quack, frog – ribbit, bird – tweet.
calendar: Wednesday 25 Nov 2026, New York 04:42 = slot 1 = Animals & their sounds / nature. Series: #1 cow 'moo' (4 Nov, farm), #2 elephant (11 Nov, zoo) -> #3 park pond animals (duck, frog, bird).
place: SUNNY PARK (reference park.jpg), at the duck pond with the little wooden bridge behind; playground and bench out of frame

variety.outfit: OUTDOOR (light blue t-shirt with yellow star, navy shorts)

characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.
supporting_objects: LITTLE DUCK (round fluffy white, orange beak), LITTLE FROG (round bright green, eyes on top, wide smile), LITTLE BIRD (round small blue with yellow tummy) – one each, toy-like, never scary.

shots.frame: f1 – duck pops up onto the stone beside him with a splash, big wow gasp; no frog, no bird
f2 – frog on the stone, Jimmy hands up like a frog; duck gone
f3 – bird lands on the stone, wings open; Jimmy arms out like wings
f4 – duck, frog, bird in a neat row on the stone; Jimmy points at the frog
f5 – edit of f1: same framing, three animals in a row on the stone, bye-bye wave

learning.goal: Say which animal makes which sound: duck – quack, frog – ribbit, bird – tweet.
learning.shown_how: One animal at a time on the same stone beside Jimmy's face (duck, then frog, then bird), then all three in a clear row; he points at the frog for the answer.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:20 'Who says ribbit? Hmm?' + 0:20-0:22 wordless humming pause -> 0:22 'The frog! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 'Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me!' (0:09) and 'Flap, flap, flap! Flap with me!' (0:15)
learning.fact_check: Duck says quack, frog says ribbit, bird says tweet (standard English toddler animal sounds). Counts checked in frames: f1 1 duck, f2 1 frog, f3 1 bird, f4 3, f5 3; frog is the middle animal he points at.
learning.modeling: Positive: Jimmy watches the animals gently from the grass, never grabs them; nothing wrong to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, big face, calm sunny pond, cute round animals, nothing scary.
